senses.gloss:
Son,Ⓒs.ⒹputraH, sutaH, tanayaH, sUnuH, AtmajaH, AtmasaMBavaH, naMdanaH, aMgajaH, tanu(nU)nuH, dArakaH, kumAraH; oft. ex. by deriv.; ‘s(on) of Dasaratha’ dASaraTiH; gAMgeyaH, pAMqavaH, &c.; ‘s(ister)-in-law’ jAmAtf m.
Ⓝ[Son]less,Ⓒa.Ⓓaputra, niputrika, niHsaMtAna.

Soon,Ⓒadv.ⒹacireRa, acirAt, avilaMbaM, ASu, sadyaH, Jawiti, sapadi; drAk, drutaM; See Quickly; ‘as s(oon) as’ (‘so s(oon)’), ‘no s(oon)er than’ ex. by yAvat-tAvat, ca-ca, mAtra in comp.; See Scarcely.
Ⓝ[Soon]er,Ⓒadv.ⒹvaraM; SIGraM; ‘s(ooner) or later’ adya Svo vA; ‘this is s(ooner) said than done’ vaktaM sukaramidaM na tu kartuM.

Sonorous,Ⓒa.ⒹmaDura, maMjula.
Ⓑ
 2 vyakta, spazwa, parisPuwa, vyaktavarRa.
Ⓑ
 3 virAvin, ucca, muKara, Sabdana, GozaRa, Sabda-Dvani-kara (rI f.).
Ⓝ[Sonorous]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹmaDuraM, spazwaM; uccEH; mahASabdena.
Ⓝ[Sonorous]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹmADuryaM, spazwatA, uccattA, muKaratA.

Zone,Ⓒs.ⒹmeKalA, raSa(sa)nA, kAMcI; See Girdle.
Ⓑ
 2 maMqalaM, (BU-)valayaH-yaM, kawibaMDaH.
